description: On the owner's yes to an ad you offered, once they have seen the offer: keeps the picture (or the owner's own files), writes the ad's words in the business's voice and the buyers' language (a few tokens) and raises one card with where, who, the days and the most it can spend. Leave set_id out and it is for the picture or the owner's files you last offered in this chat, on the terms you offered, the countries too; name only what the owner changed. For the owner's files from an earlier offer, or files you didn't offer in this chat, name their attachments (with as) or film_id. Nothing spends until someone who may spend presses Start on that card. For a post to boost, the card comes once the post is live: until then it says so. Say what the card holds and that it waits for their Start. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

as.description: with two or more attachments: one_ad (one ad with its tall 9:16 version for Stories and Reels) or carousel (2 to 10 pictures, in the order given); one attachment is one ad

attachments.description: the owner's own finished picture, video or pictures to run as they are, by their attachment ids (input.attached or attachment_read, sent here, on Telegram or Slack, or through an upload link), only when they ask to run the file itself; in place of set_id

brief.description: the owner's own words for the ad (an offer, an angle), when they gave some

caption.description: with attachments: what they sell and to whom, in the owner's words, when they said; the ad's words are written from it

countries.description: the countries for this ad (two-letter ISO codes), only when the owner named or changed them; omitted, as offered, which is Where ads may run unless countries were named then

ends_on.description: the day it ends (YYYY-MM-DD), when the owner changed it; omitted, as offered

film_id.description: a film Marsell made, whose plan the owner approved, to run as a video ad; in place of set_id

item_id.description: the picture in the set; omitted, its first made picture

language.description: the buyers' language, when it is not the language of this chat

link.description: where the ad sends people, when the owner named a page; omitted, the business's website

per_day.description: the amount a day, when the owner changed it, in their ad account's currency (20 for $20); omitted, as offered

place.description: the place the owner named for the ad; omitted, where it was offered

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

set_id.description: the picture's set; left out, the picture this chat last offered as an ad

starts_on.description: the day it starts (YYYY-MM-DD), when the owner changed it; omitted, as offered

title.description: with attachments: what they are, in a few words, when the owner said

name: ad_card
title: Ad card
